page.overview:
What is Xura?

Xura is a coastal region in the Dreamlands of Earth, also known as the "Land of Pleasures Unattained", which first appeared in H. P. Lovecraft's short story "The White Ship".

From the sea the lily-lined coastline appears idyllic, with beautiful groves as far as the eye can see from which harmonic singing and snatches of laughter can be heard. However getting closer the wind carries the lethal, charnel odor of plague-stricken towns and uncovered cemeteries.
